headlines.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general after weeks of uncertainty
headlines.description: The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as U.S. attorney general early Saturday in a mostly party-line vote, capping off weeks of uncertainty and despite bipartisan concerns about his ability to run a Justice Department independent of President Donald Trump’s impulses.

headlines.title: Senate passes short-term bill to prevent a shutdown before the midterm elections
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Senate voted 90-6 early Saturday to pass a short-term funding bill to remove the threat of a government shutdown before the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Appeals court deals major setback to Trump's White House ballroom
headlines.description: A federal appeals court says Congress should have approved President Trump's White House ballroom project, ordering above-ground construction halted while pausing its ruling to allow the administration to appeal. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: Haley Stevens says there’s ‘no drama’ after primary loss to Abdul El-Sayed: Full interview
headlines.description: Rep. Haley Stevens (D-Mich.) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss her narrow defeat by progressive Abdul El-Sayed in the divisive Michigan Democratic Senate primary and why she’s now calling for unity ahead of the November midterms.

headlines.title: New jobs report shows unexpected loss as White House tries to ‘sound optimistic’
headlines.description: A new jobs report reveals employers cut 23,000 jobs in July, suggesting Trump’s labor market is weakening. NBC News correspondents Gabe Gutierrez and Brian Cheung report on the latest numbers. NBC’s Keir Simmons discusses the latest developments in the Iran War and its ongoing impacts on the U.S. economy.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Fault lines for both parties emerge after Michigan’s primaries: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Kristen Welker looks ahead to November in swing state Michigan after this week’s primary battles.

headlines.title: Sen. Bill Cassidy, a critical Republican holdout, backs Todd Blanche for attorney general
headlines.description: Republican Sens. Lisa Murkowski of Alaska and Susan Collins of Maine said they would oppose Blanche. But Cassidy’s support means he will likely be confirmed.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll appeal decision halting ballroom construction to the Supreme Court
headlines.description: A federal appeals court affirmed a federal judge’s ruling to block construction of the White House ballroom while allowing below-ground construction to move forward.

headlines.title: Senate passes sanctions bill on Russia and Iran named for late Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Senate voted overwhelmingly to pass legislation to impose sanctions against Russia and Iran after months of fits and starts, with the death of Republican Sen.

headlines.title: Rep. Andy Ogles loses his Republican primary in Tennessee
headlines.description: Rep. Andy Ogles of Tennessee has lost his Republican primary, NBC News projects, falling to a former state official in a primary season that has seen an unusually high number of incumbents lose renomination.

headlines.title: Sen. Marsha Blackburn wins the Republican primary for governor of Tennessee
headlines.description: Blackburn, a longtime Trump ally, defeated Rep. John Rose for the nomination, NBC News projects, after the president decided not to endorse in the race.
